scenes.headline: How RL becomes a compiler for a tiny retriever
scenes.sub: Retrieve-for-Train: train a 4B policy once, then throw it away.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Comet! Retrieve-for-Train asks whether reinforcement learning can be a compiler: run it once, keep what it learned, and delete the model that learned it.

scenes.text: Use RL once to turn a reward you can't differentiate into ordinary supervised targets. Then train a small model on them, and delete the policy.
scenes.say: The idea: use RL once, to turn a reward you can't differentiate into ordinary training targets. Then train a small model on them.

scenes.title: A reward for a good set
scenes.say: Some searches want a good set, like ten outfits for a festival. That reward can be computed, not differentiated.

parts.note: keeps sub-queries near items that exist in the index
parts.say: Groundedness, weighted most, keeps each sub-query near something that exists in the index.

parts.note: Vendi Score over the items retrieved
cosine similarity back to the original query
parts.say: Alignment keeps it on topic. Only with all three terms does training stay stable.

scenes.title: Compile, then throw the compiler away

items.text: Train a fan-out LM with GRPO
items.say: Stage one: train a four billion parameter model with GRPO to fan each query out into sub-queries that earn that reward.
Stage two: freeze it and sample it a hundred and twenty-eight times per query. Its outputs become the targets.
Stage three: a small diffusion model learns to map a query straight to a block of item embeddings.
Nearest neighbour turns those embeddings into items. The big model never runs again.

scenes.label: speedup plotted in the paper's own figure, depending on batch size
scenes.note: the 20x appears only in one prose sentence
scenes.say: It is faster. The paper's own figure shows eight to sixteen times, depending on batch size. The twenty times in the headlines comes from one sentence of prose.

scenes.text: Any reward you can compute but not differentiate can be pushed through a policy once and harvested as training data.

recap: A set-level reward, optimized once by RL
The policy's samples become supervised targets
A 53.9M diffusion retriever replaces the 4B model
scenes.say: To recap: optimize a set-level reward once, harvest the policy's samples, and ship a small diffusion retriever instead.
